module.name: CNEInstance Ready Gate
module.description: Cloud-agnostic readiness gate for a BNK CNEInstance. Polls the operator-written .status (F5TmmAvailable && CNEControllerAvailable, with a status.state Ready/Running fallback) after the CR is applied; dumps pod diagnostics and fails closed on timeout. Ported from awsbnkctl phase25_activation_poll.go. Deliberately ignores the rollup Available condition (H1).

required.name: instance_namespace
required.description: Namespace where the CNEInstance CR lives.

required.name: instance_name
required.description: Name of the CNEInstance CR to poll.

key_outputs.name: cneinstance_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — null_resource id produced only after the operator reported the instance functional.
